If the brake pads thickness falls below a certain level, the driver will be informed that the brake pads need to be replaced by the permanently lit warning lamp and warning message "Check brake pads.

In this case, the brake performance would still not be impaired.
Once the vehicle is taken to the workshop, the brake pads on the rear axle will also be checked and replaced, if necessary.

Furthermore, the force distribution of the brake system prohibits that the brake pads on the rear axle could reach the wear limit before the brake pads of the front axle reach their wear limit.

claims.label: Block reports component manufacturer: NTN Corporation
Narrative (cause/chronology) names the supplier: NTN Corporation
claims.quote: A hole in a water pipe caused a reduction in the flow rate of cooling water around the outer race during the heat treatment process on the supplier’s manufacturing line, resulting in improper cooling to the inner surface of the race and causing quench cracking to the outer surface of the race.

events.quote: The supplier’s initial findings indicated that there had been no outflow to Subaru.
events.entry_quote: August 30, 2023 – The supplier identified quench cracking on the outer diameter of the outer race during magnetic particle inspection.

events.quote: September 14, 2023 – After a reevaluation of scope, the supplier determined that affected product had been shipped to Subaru.
Subaru received information from the supplier indicating a crack on the surface of an outer race of the front drive shaft assembly.
events.entry_quote: September 14, 2023 – After a reevaluation of scope, the supplier determined that affected product had been shipped to Subaru.

events.quote: Subaru and the supplier initiated a joint study to determine the safety impact of a crack in the outer race.
events.entry_quote: September 14, 2023 – After a reevaluation of scope, the supplier determined that affected product had been shipped to Subaru.

events.quote: Subaru worked with the part supplier to trace the affected parts based on the lot number information.
events.entry_quote: October 2023 – The supplier presented their findings of the scope of affected parts shipments.

events.quote: However, out of an abundance of caution, Subaru decided to conduct a safety recall.
events.entry_quote: November 2, 2023 – For the entire population of potentially affected vehicles, Subaru is not aware of any field reports, warranty claims, or VOQs.
